verdict.rationale: Docusign exposes a REST API, official Node.js SDK, and OpenAPI/Swagger specs used to generate client SDKs, which are the standard building blocks for headless/CI automation of signing and agreement workflows (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-13/40, docusign-gh-1/2/3). Community reports confirm the REST API can be integrated programmatically without a UI (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5), though other reports describe friction and workarounds needed for embedded/automated flows (docusign-comm-1, docusign-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, a documented CLI, or first-party guidance on running Docusign flows unattended in automated test/build environments.
